main_measure.name: mean 6-bar unusual move after long bets (return minus coin's normal 6-bar drift), before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and thin-minus-heavy > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, thinner-volume half minus heavier-volume half

decided_by: t >= 2 but the thin-minus-heavy difference is <= 0 (or not measurable), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Situation taken as a down hour (raw fall < 0, or the price return where unrecorded) with a positive forecast; bets per the holding-period rule with one case per 6-bar cell; volume halves split as v <= median (thinner) versus v > median (heavier), cases without a valid v left out of the split.
